source_vintage_note: The Census Bureau notes that 2024 LODES lacks data on Alaska and Michigan workers. Counts are those present in the Illinois files used.
geography: 2020 Census block internal points and official CTA stop coordinates deduplicated by station map ID. Membership is all or none for each block (WGS 84 geodesic distance to its Census internal point).
method: Sum WAC C000 and RAC C000 by the selected block IDs. Separately sum OD S000 across Illinois main and auxiliary files for workplaces in those blocks. Classify each OD row by whether its home block also belongs to the same area. Sum WAC CNS10 and CNS12 independently by workplace.
scope: Straight-line circles around transit stations. Workplace jobs are linked to an establishment, not a measured daytime headcount, store visits, sales, commute schedule or walking catchment.
